about: Invented knowledge for the recall and sensitive content checks in verify (P6-05). Every page, source and name is made up. The checks put it into the built-in store and into a fake Waymarks on this machine. The loader does not read this folder.

pages.title: Apple tree
pages.body: The apple tree by the gate is pruned in February, before the buds open.

pages.title: Borage
pages.body: Borage seeds itself along the path. The bees like its blue flowers.

pages.title: Chives
pages.body: The chives are divided every third spring and planted out by the kitchen door.

pages.title: Runner beans
pages.body: Runner beans go in the north bed after the last frost. They climb the hazel poles and want water every evening in July.

pages.title: Tomatoes
pages.body: Tomatoes stay in the greenhouse until June. Pinch out the side shoots each week.

pages.title: Attic boards
pages.body: The attic boards were laid in the spring. Six boards are left in the shed.

pages.title: Bathroom tiles
pages.body: Two of the bathroom tiles by the bath are cracked. Spare tiles are in the attic.

pages.title: Garden gate
pages.body: The garden gate sticks after rain. The top hinge wants a new screw.

pages.title: Shed roof
pages.body: The shed roof needs new felt before winter: two rolls of felt and a tin of adhesive.

pages.title: Sleep notes
pages.body: Melatonin helped with the insomnia in March. The clinic suggested no screens after nine.
